layers.label: Intake
layers.purpose: Clarify repository, acceptance criteria, risk boundaries, and write permissions.

layers.label: Codebase Intelligence
layers.purpose: Inspect project rules, architecture, dependency paths, and impact areas.

layers.label: Design
layers.purpose: Choose architecture, UX, API, data, or skill design before writing.

layers.label: Build
layers.purpose: Modify code, tests, docs, scripts, registries, and configuration.

layers.label: Quality
layers.purpose: Run tests, browser checks, visual QA, security review, and verification.

layers.label: Release
layers.purpose: Prepare handoff, commits, PRs, CI checks, deployment, and rollback notes.

stages.purpose: Clarify goal, repository, risk, acceptance criteria, and write boundaries.
Inspect project rules, codebase structure, existing patterns, and related files.
Choose architecture, UX, API, data, or skill-design approach.
Write a durable implementation plan when the task is multi-step.
Edit code, docs, schemas, tests, scripts, or configuration.
Reproduce failures, isolate root cause, and validate fixes.
Create or update unit, integration, E2E, or regression tests.
Run browser automation or screenshots for web app behavior.
Check responsive UI, layout, screenshots, and visual acceptance.
Scan security-sensitive diffs, threat models, or vulnerabilities.
Prepare commits, PRs, CI checks, deployment, and rollback notes.
Summarize files changed, verification, risks, and next steps.

skills.name: understand
skills.use_when: The repo is unfamiliar or the user needs architecture/flow orientation.
skills.install_hint: Recommended for larger or unfamiliar repositories.

skills.name: codegraph
skills.use_when: A pre-indexed code knowledge graph can speed up impact analysis.
skills.install_hint: Recommended when available, but always backstop with text search.

skills.name: planning-with-files
skills.use_when: The task needs a written plan across multiple files or stages.

skills.name: systematic-implementation
skills.use_when: The user asks to implement, modify, integrate, or refactor code.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.use_when: The user reports a bug, failure, flaky test, runtime error, or regression.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.use_when: The feature or bug can be driven by focused failing tests.
skills.install_hint: Recommended when acceptance behavior is testable.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.use_when: Before claiming code is fixed, passing, deployed, or ready.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.use_when: The task changes frontend UX, visual design, components, or responsive behavior.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.use_when: A web app needs browser interaction, E2E validation, screenshots, or UI behavior checks.

skills.name: shadcn
skills.use_when: The project uses shadcn/ui components or needs shadcn component management.

skills.name: supabase
skills.use_when: The task involves Supabase, Postgres policies, auth, storage, or migrations.

skills.name: next-best-practices
skills.use_when: The project uses Next.js or the user asks for Next.js architecture or performance guidance.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.use_when: The task involves OpenAI API, ChatGPT, Assistants, Responses, or current OpenAI product usage.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.use_when: The user wants to create, edit, evaluate, or package a skill.

skills.name: git-commit
skills.use_when: The user explicitly asks for a commit or release-ready git change.

skills.name: github-pr-creation
skills.use_when: The user explicitly asks to open a GitHub pull request.

skills.name: deploy-to-vercel
skills.use_when: The user asks to deploy an application or website to Vercel.

pipelines.label: Design, implement, and verify a feature

stages.agent_role: Context agent inspects project rules, nearby patterns, and impact areas.
Planning agent turns findings into a checkable implementation sequence.
Test agent defines or updates acceptance tests in parallel when file ownership is separable.
Implementation agent edits the production path while coordinating with the test branch.
Verification agent runs checks and summarizes the outcome.

pipelines.label: Reproduce, debug, fix, and verify a bug

stages.agent_role: Debugging agent reproduces the failure and identifies root cause before edits.
Fix agent changes the smallest responsible code path.
Regression-test agent captures the failure if test files can be isolated.
Verification agent reruns the repro and relevant tests.

pipelines.label: Implement and visually verify frontend/UI changes

stages.agent_role: Context agent inspects app structure, existing components, and design conventions.
Design agent chooses UX, component, responsive, and visual approach.
Acceptance-test agent prepares behavior checks while design is being finalized.
Implementation agent edits components, styles, and states.
Browser agent verifies interactions and captures runtime evidence.
Visual QA agent checks layout, responsive behavior, and polish.

pipelines.label: Change backend, database, API, or auth behavior

stages.agent_role: Context agent maps service, schema, auth, and test boundaries.
Design agent chooses API/data/auth approach and migration risk gates.
Backend agent edits service, schema, or integration code.
Test agent updates unit/integration coverage for the changed behavior.
Verification agent runs relevant checks and reports residual risks.

pipelines.label: Create, edit, evaluate, or package a skill

stages.agent_role: Skill-design agent defines trigger description, progressive disclosure, registry shape, and expected reports.
Implementation agent edits SKILL.md, references, scripts, installer, or registry files.
Eval/test agent updates fixtures or smoke tests for routing behavior.
Verification agent validates install, plan output, and process-report clarity.

pipelines.label: Prepare commit, PR, CI, or deployment

stages.agent_role: Verification agent checks final local state before release work.
Release agent prepares commit, PR, deployment, or release notes only when explicitly requested.

pipelines.label: Implement or debug OpenAI API usage

stages.agent_role: Docs agent verifies current official OpenAI API behavior before design decisions.
Implementation agent updates integration code.
Test agent adds mocks, contract tests, or regression coverage.
Verification agent runs checks and reports API/version assumptions.
